run_track_obbs_cli: run the Obb tracker CLI on an input folder with --input path to track oriented bounding boxes
run_track_obbs_function: call track_obbs with an input CSV path and probability thresholds to track oriented bounding boxes across snippets
run_track_obbs_custom_thresholds: run track_obbs with custom prob_inst_thr and prob_assoc_thr thresholds for fine-tuned OBB tracking
review_track_obbs: review the track_obbs function that reads snippet OBB CSVs and writes tracked and scene-level OBB outputs
review_ObbTracker_config: review the ObbTracker configuration parameters including max_assoc_dist, nms thresholds, and weight limits in track_obbs
